summary:
Senior transformation and marketing leader with 20+ years of experience driving large-scale digital, data, marketing, and revenue
programs across diverse industries. Proven ability to convert business strategy into high-impact execution through advanced analytics,
campaign leadership, digital transformation, and regulatory modernization. Recognized for building scalable growth engines, optimizing
customer experience, and delivering measurable business outcomes.

skills._method: flashtext_skills_section | fuzzy(Change Management→Change Management(100%), digital transformation→Digital Transformation(100%))

bullets: Directed enterprise-wide execution of all promotional and service campaigns across Email, SMS, Net Banking, ATM, OCC, CRM, BEU, and Branch channels, consistently delivering 99.9%+ First-Time-Right (FTR) execution.
Led complex, data-driven campaign operations leveraging SQL, Oracle and ETL platforms, enabling precision targeting, personalization, and compliance at scale.
Built and governed a rigorous quality assurance framework, eliminating deployment errors and embedding a culture of zero-defect delivery across the organization.
Managed and developed campaign operations team, instituting standardized processes, continuous training, and performance governance to sustain 99.9%+ delivery accuracy.
Optimized digital communication investments, achieving significant cost efficiencies through advanced frequency capping, suppression logic, DNC enforcement, and consent governance.
Owned vendor ecosystem and regulatory compliance across TRAI DLT, GDPR, and data privacy frameworks, maintaining 100% audit readiness.
Drove digital modernization by evaluating, piloting, and deploying next-generation campaign platforms and automation tools.
Partnered strategically with Product, IT, Analytics, Risk, Compliance, and external vendors to ensure seamless execution and BAU stability.
Governed campaign financial operations including invoice validation, reconciliation, and purchase order management, ensuring strong commercial discipline and budget control.

Led strategic planning and execution of enterprise marketing campaigns aligned to core business objectives including Retention, New Acquisition, Contextual Communication, and Communication Frequency Optimization.
Conceptualized and designed high-impact D2C marketing campaigns to drive customer spend, revenue growth, and accelerated digital acquisition.
Orchestrated large-scale multi-channel marketing programs leveraging email marketing, mobile (SMS / notifications), and performance media across Facebook, Instagram, and Google Ads.
Converted deep consumer insights and advanced analytics into actionable marketing strategies that consistently generated measurable customer and business value.
Served as key liaison between Marketing and Technology, translating business objectives into data and technical requirements while resolving complex data challenges.
Owned end-to-end marketing reporting and performance monitoring in partnership with Analytics teams, delivering real-time visibility for leadership and channel owners.
Enabled faster, data-driven decision-making by providing real-time reports, projections, and optimization insights across channels.
Designed and implemented a Linear Programming optimization model to create optimal weekly CRM calendars and drive efficient budget allocation for social prospecting channels.
Built executive-level dashboards and performance reports using Adobe Analytics and Report Builder, delivering clear and actionable insights for stakeholders.
Led creation of monthly and daily traffic targets and detailed traffic planning for all digital channels and categories.
Acted as Single Point of Contact for all ad-hoc marketing analytics, data requests, and performance deep-dives across Adobe Analytics and marketing metrics.
Conceptualized and operationalized a customer segmentation framework enabling CRM channels to convert recent buyers into high-frequency customers.
Directed analytics-driven transformation projects including automation of daily MIS reporting using Data Studio and Tableau, and continuous industry and competitor benchmarking.

Transformed Campaign Capabilities: Delivered a major transformation project to enhance Vodafone India's campaign capabilities across various outbound/inbound conventional and digital channels, resulting in an increase in campaign reach and engagement.
Awarded “Best Employee”: Conferred with the “Best Employee Award” for outstanding performance in the FlyTxt Rollout Work, recognizing exceptional contributions and achievements.
